subject: general
question: Which institution is the country's premier organisation for literary discourse, publication and promotion, and the only one that does so in 24 Indian languages, including English?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sahitya Akademi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sahitya Akademi** was established in **1954** by the Government of India to promote and **preserve literature **in Indian languages.
 
• It has its headquarters in** New Delhi** and regional offices in different parts of the country.
 
• Sahitya Akademi organizes** literary events, awards, and fellowships **to recognize and encourage writers in different languages.
 
• The organization also publishes books in various Indian languages, including **translations of works** from other languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **English and Foreign Languages University** is located in** Hyderabad.**

 
 
• It offers courses in** English and foreign languages.**
 
 
 
• **Hindi Granth Academy** is based in **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is dedicated to promoting **Hindi literature.**
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Open University** is located in **New Delhi.**
 
 
• It offers distance** education programs.**
